Commercial & Residential Electrician, Fixhero Electric Full-Service Solutions From Licensed - TX Electricians.

We provide full-service electrical solutions, including electrical installation, electrical repair, and maintenance. Our uniformed and licensed electricians can assist you with electric service upgrades, meter and panel replacements, and house rewiring. We have over 25 years of experience, and if you need an electrician for anything within your home, we can handle the job.
